name: writing-practice-on-celld
description: A persistent agentic writing desk built on celld Durable Objects.
author: Aleksei Krasnoperov <aleksei@krasnoperov.me>

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src test scripts evals frontend/src frontend/vite.config.js frontend/svelte.config.js
